lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: Ugh, this heat is unbearable out here on guard duty...

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: C.A.T. drill just ended, but I can barely stand in this sun.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Jules! I'm looking for a receipt.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Enzo said it might have been dropped near the bleachers during the lunch rush.

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: Oh, I might have seen something like that.

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: But look, I'm stuck out here on guard duty for my C.A.T. squad, and I am absolutely melting in this heat.

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: Do me a quick favor?

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: Go grab me an ice-cold bottle of water from the canteen.

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: Do that, and I'll help you look for your paper.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Uhm... sure, Jules.

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: Did you get it yet?

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: I'll pay you back, I promise... It's just 15 pesos.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Here's your water, fully chilled.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Now, about that receipt?

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: You mean this?

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: I found it near the trash can after the C.A.T. drill.

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: I figured it was important since it had 'Fuel' and 'Admin' stamped on the header.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: That's exactly it!

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I need to bring that back to the office.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Without the physical copy to re-scan, I can't prove the budget was tampered with.

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: Here.

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: Better keep it safe.

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: If Mr. Reyes sees you with that, he'll do more than just use a red pen on your work.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Thanks, Jules.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: Time to go back and fix the layout.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I've got to make sure this proof fits perfectly into the story.

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: Ugh, this heat is unbearable out here on guard duty...

lines.speaker: Jules
lines.text: C.A.T. drill just ended, but I can barely stand in this sun.
